title: Loop content of bond percolation on hyperbolic triangulations: an exact identity and a $1/λ$ expansion
summary: We study the homology of percolation clusters on disk-shaped patches of the regular $\{3,q\}$ triangle tilings for $q\ge7$. Varying $q$ gives a one-parameter family of hyperbolic tilings, from mildly curved ($q=7$) to deeply hyperbolic ($q=20$), and this paper measures and derives loop content as a function of curvature. A single growth-rate parameter $λ(q)$, the asymptotic ratio of successive ring sizes, governs every result.
